column1: # tools/app/zephyr/v4.4.2/helpers.tsv -- the compiler runtime helpers a board
# lane admits (decision 0021; the owner's decision of 2026-10-20), with the
# stack each one needs.
# The DOOM entries compute in signed 64 bits, and on the M33 the compiler's
# back end lowers 64-bit division to these calls after the IR the stack tool
# reads, so an entry's kernel_stack does not count them. A core_session build
# adds the largest helper frame chain of the helpers an entry's object calls
# to that entry's DoomCore stack, and refuses a helper with no row here.
# bytes is read from the archive's own instructions (llvm-objdump -dr of its
# members at the sha256 below), the deepest chain from the helper's entry:
# an attestation, bound to the archive the link uses -- step 10 refuses an
# image whose map names another archive, or this one with other bytes.
# archive is the multilib path under the SDK's gcc library directory; a build
# takes the rows of its target's multilib (thumb/v8-m.main/ on the M33s,
# thumb/v7e-m/ on the FRDM-IMXRT1186's Cortex-M7, decision 0023).
# symbol
__aeabi_ldivmod
column5: _aeabi_ldivmod.o pushes 16 (strd r12, lr, [sp, #-16]!) and calls __udivmoddi4, whose push.w {r4-r10, lr} is 32 and which calls nothing; the zero-divisor path tail-calls __aeabi_ldiv0 (_dvmd_tls.o: bx lr) before pushing
